description: The bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment” visually compares the inference runtime (in seconds) of five different models under streaming conditions. The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, ranging from 0 to 400 with major gridlines at 50-second intervals. The horizontal axis lists the models: “Our Joint Framework” (colored dark green), “ChatGPT”, “DeepSeek”, “LLaMA”, and “Claude” (all colored light blue). According to the legend, the green bar corresponds to “Our Joint Framework”, while the light blue bars represent “LLM Models”. The runtime values are explicitly labeled atop each bar: “Our Joint Framework” achieves the lowest runtime at 77 seconds; “ChatGPT” follows at 190 seconds; “DeepSeek” has the highest runtime at 365 seconds; “LLaMA” runs at 172 seconds; and “Claude” at 243 seconds. The chart clearly illustrates that “Our Joint Framework” significantly outperforms all tested LLMs in terms of speed under streaming conditions, with runtimes more than 2x faster than the next best LLM (LLaMA) and over 4x faster than the slowest (DeepSeek). The bars are not sorted by runtime, but arranged to highlight the contrast between the proposed framework and the baseline LLMs.
